cohort: One hundred and seventy pregnant women (18-44 years old) with a gestational age exceeding 8 weeks and a history of three or more consecutive first-trimester pregnancy losses were included.
finding: LMWH treatment was associated with a significantly higher live birth rate (88.0% vs. 73.4%) in women with unexplained recurrent pregnancy loss compared to placebo.
mod_finding: The proportion of caesarean section was significantly higher in the LMWH group (72.6%) compared to the placebo group (51.7%).
